# vpsie_control_platforms (Data Source)

Lists the platforms outside VPSie (VMware, Nutanix, public clouds) the account manages with Control.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vpsie_control_platforms" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) Whether Control is on for the account. When it is not, the list is empty and `reason` says why.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `platforms` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--platforms))
- `reason` (String) Why Control is not available: `notLicensed`, `disabledByOperator` or `disabledForTenant`.

<a id="nestedatt--platforms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `platforms`

Read-Only:

- `access_mode` (String) `read` or `operate`.
- `connector_type` (String) The platform type, for example `vmware-vcenter` or `aws-ec2`.
- `endpoint_host` (String) The host the collector connects to.
- `identifier` (String) The platform identifier.
- `last_sync_at` (String) When the inventory was last read (RFC 3339).
- `last_sync_status` (String) `succeeded`, `partial` or `failed`.
- `name` (String) The platform name.
- `region` (String) The region, for a public cloud.
- `state` (String) `pending`, `connected`, `stale` or `error`.
- `vm_count` (Number) Servers in the last inventory.
